prepare_training_subvectors: prepare training subvectors by splitting a dataset into N sub-vectors for PQ-QINCo model training
train_OPQ_matrix: train an OPQ matrix on training data and save the transformation matrix for product quantization
recombine_QINCo_models: recombine multiple trained QINCo sub-models into a single PQ-QINCo model with optional OPQ matrix
run_qinco_training: run QINCo training directly via the train_qinco module when neither prepare nor recombine is specified
load_dataset_for_training: load a named dataset or custom training data file and restrict to a specified number of training vectors
